title.en: Kinetic theory of an ideal gas: pressure

heading.en: What is gas pressure made of?

hook.en: The air in a football pushes out on every square centimetre. That push is nothing but billions of molecules hitting the wall every instant and bouncing back.
hook.kn: ಫುಟ್‌ಬಾಲ್‌ನೊಳಗಿನ ಗಾಳಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಚದರ ಸೆಂಟಿಮೀಟರ್ ಮೇಲೂ ಹೊರಗೆ ತಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ತಳ್ಳುವಿಕೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಷಣ ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಬಡಿದು ಹಿಂದಿರುಗುವ ಕೋಟ್ಯಂತರ ಅಣುಗಳಿಂದ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: List the assumptions of kinetic theory

say.en: The air in a football pushes out on every square centimetre. That push is nothing but billions of molecules hitting the wall every instant and bouncing back. In this lesson: List the assumptions of kinetic theory.
Derive and use P equals (1 over 3)nm v̄ squared.

body.en: A gas is a very large number of identical molecules in random motion. The molecules are tiny compared with the distances between them, they exert no forces on each other except during collisions, and all collisions with each other and with the walls are perfectly elastic. Between collisions they move in straight lines with constant speed.
body.kn: ಅನಿಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸಂಖ್ಯ ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ಅಣುಗಳು ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕವಾಗಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಣುಗಳು ಅತಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕವು, ಘರ್ಷಣೆಯ ಹೊರತು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಬಲವಿಲ್ಲ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಗಳು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ.

say.en: A gas is a very large number of identical molecules in random motion. The molecules are tiny compared with the distances between them, they exert no forces on each other except during collisions, and all collisions with each other and with the walls are perfectly elastic. Between collisions they move in straight lines with constant speed. Random motion, negligible size.
say.kn: ಅನಿಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸಂಖ್ಯ ಒಂದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ಅಣುಗಳು ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕವಾಗಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಣುಗಳು ಅತಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕವು, ಘರ್ಷಣೆಯ ಹೊರತು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಬಲವಿಲ್ಲ, ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಘರ್ಷಣೆಗಳು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕ.

say.en: No forces except in collisions.
Perfectly elastic collisions.
A cube of side l holds the gas. Follow one molecule of mass m with velocity component v_x towards the right wall.
It bounces back with minus v_x, so it gives the wall a momentum 2 m v_x. It returns after a time 2 l over v_x.
Force from one molecule is m v_x squared over l. Add over all N molecules; random motion gives an average v_x squared of one third of v squared.
Divide by the wall area l squared: P is one third n m v-bar-squared, or one third rho v_rms squared.
For air at 1 atmosphere with density 1.29, the root mean square speed is about 485 metres per second, faster than sound.

It bounces back with minus v_x, so it gives the wall a momentum 2 m v_x. It returns after a time 2 l over v_x. Force from one molecule is m v_x squared over l. Add over all N molecules; random motion gives an average v_x squared of one third of v squared. Divide by the wall area l squared: P is one third n m v-bar-squared, or one third rho v_rms squared. For air at 1 atmosphere with density 1.29, the root mean square speed is about 485 metres per second, faster than sound.

say.en: A cube of side l holds the gas. Follow one molecule of mass m with velocity component v x towards the right wall. It bounces back with minus v x, so it gives the wall a momentum 2 metres v x. It returns after a time 2 l over v x. Force from one molecule is m v x squared over l. Add over all N molecules; random motion gives an average v x squared of one third of v squared. Divide by the wall area l squared: P is one third n m v-bar-squared, or one third rho v rms squared. For air at 1 atmosphere with density 1.29, the root mean square speed is about 485 metres per second, faster than sound.

narration.en: Kinetic theory gives P = (1/3) ρ v², where ρ is the density of the gas and v the rms speed of its molecules. For air at room temperature, ρ ≈ 1.2 kg/m³ and v ≈ 500 m/s give about 100 kPa: atmospheric pressure.
narration.kn: ಚಲನ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ P = (1/3) ρ v² ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ; ρ ಅನಿಲದ ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ, v ಅಣುಗಳ rms ವೇಗ. ಕೊಠಡಿ ತಾಪದ ಗಾಳಿಗೆ ρ ≈ 1.2 kg/m³, v ≈ 500 m/s ಆದರೆ ಸುಮಾರು 100 kPa: ವಾತಾವರಣದ ಒತ್ತಡ.

body.en: Each molecule hitting a wall reverses its momentum component, 2mvₓ. Adding the momentum given to the wall each second by all molecules, and using v̄ₓ² = v̄²/3 for random motion, gives P = (1/3) n m v̄², where n is the number of molecules per unit volume. Since nm = ρ, P = (1/3)ρ v_rms².
body.kn: ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಬಡಿಯುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಣು 2mvₓ ಸಂವೇಗ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ P = (1/3) n m v̄² = (1/3)ρ v_rms².

narration.en: Each molecule hitting a wall reverses its momentum component, 2mvₓ. Adding the momentum given to the wall each second by all molecules, and using v̄ₓ² = v̄²/3 for random motion, gives P = (1/3) n m v̄², where n is the number of molecules per unit volume. Since nm = ρ, P = (1/3)ρ v_rms².

say.en: Each molecule hitting a wall reverses its momentum component, 2mv x. Adding the momentum given to the wall each second by all molecules, and using v̄ x squared equals v̄ squared/3 for random motion, gives P equals (1 over 3) n m v̄ squared, where n is the number of molecules per unit volume. Since nm equals rho, P equals (1 over 3) rho v rms squared. P equals (1 over 3)nm v̄ squared.
say.kn: ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಬಡಿಯುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಣು 2mv x ಸಂವೇಗ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ P equals (1 over 3) n m v̄ squared equals (1 over 3) rho v rms squared.

problem.en: Nitrogen at 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa has a density of 1.25 kg m⁻³. Find the rms speed of its molecules.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Nitrogen at 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa has a density of 1.25 kg m⁻³. Find the rms speed of its molecules.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Nitrogen at 1.0 times 10 to the power 5 pascals has a density of 1.25 kilograms m to the power minus 3. Find the rms speed of its molecules.
v rms equals the square root of (3P/ rho).
= the square root of (3 times 10 to the power 5 divided by 1.25) equals the square root of (2.4 times 10 to the power 5).
is approximately 490 metres s to the power minus 1.
So the answer is About 490 metres s to the power minus 1.
